subject: SolidGeometry
question: All tank dimensions are in decimetres, and x>0. The full cylindrical tank leaks at 3πx litres per second. Find the water remaining after (2x+2)² seconds, in expanded form.
original_question: As shown in the figure, the cylindrical water tank is leaking at a constant rate of 3\pi x litres per second (where x is a fixed unknown). If the water tank was initially full, calculate the amount of water remaining after \left(2x+2\right)^2 seconds. Give your simplified answer in expanded form.
